mapper.select: INSERT INTO platform_tenant (tenant_id, manager_id) VALUES ('tn_' || lpad(nextval('tenant_number')::text, 5, '0'), #{managerId}) RETURNING tenant_id
SELECT tenant_id FROM platform_user WHERE username = #{username} AND NOT is_deleted
SELECT tenant_id FROM platform_user WHERE id = #{identityId} AND NOT is_deleted
SELECT tenant_id FROM platform_access_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND NOT is_deleted AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT u.tenant_id, t.manager_id = u.id AS manager FROM platform_user u JOIN platform_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND NOT t.is_deleted WHERE u.id = #{accountId} AND NOT u.is_deleted
